title: Sectoral inter-dependencies drive the loss of structural balance in signed financial networks
abstract: arXiv:2608.12023v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Signed graphs provide an effective architecture for portraying a system in which cooperation and conflict coexist. Emerging from the concept of balance in psychological sciences, they have found applications across several domains. Financial markets are one such example that can be modeled using signed networks, where assets exhibit correlations in price movements. During periods of systemic risk, such a signed financial network shows a loss of balance, which has been consistently demonstrated. Here, we explore how this structural imbalance is distributed across scales within the financial network, revealing its mesoscopic origin. Adopting the framework of structural balance theory, we use a measure of polarization based on triadic motifs to investigate the distribution of structural imbalance across varying sectoral scales. translated_title: 部门间相互依赖导致带符号金融网络中结构平衡的丧失
translated_abstract: 带符号图提供了一种有效的架构来描述合作与冲突共存的系统。这一概念源于心理科学中的平衡理论，并已在多个领域得到应用。金融市场就是其中一个例子，可以通过带符号网络进行建模，其中资产的价格变动表现出相关性。在系统性风险期间，这种带符号金融网络表现出平衡的丧失，这一点已被一致证实。在此，我们探讨这种结构不平衡如何在金融网络中的不同尺度上分布，揭示其介观起源。采用结构平衡理论的框架，我们使用基于三元组基序的极化度量来研究结构不平衡在不同部门尺度上的分布。我们利用纵向数据分析了全局极化及其部门组成部分的时间演变。
tldr: 本文通过极化度量分析发现，金融网络中结构平衡的丧失主要由部门间相互依赖驱动，其不平衡分布在介观尺度上具有显著特征。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that sectoral inter-dependencies drive the loss of structural balance in signed financial networks, with imbalance distributed distinctively at mesoscopic scales.
